from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPSData(BaseModel):
    """Earnings per share data from one company's 10-Q filing for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="Basic earnings per share value")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share value")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (YYYY-MM format)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_data: list[CompanyEPSData]
